name_zh: 柬埔寨·西哈努克：国王舞者外交与中立生存
name_en: Cambodia Sihanouk: King Dancer Diplomacy & Neutral Survival
description_zh: 诺罗敦·西哈努克 (1922-2012) 柬埔寨国王/亲王/首相，1953谈判独立，1955退位从政，1970政变流亡北京，1975红色高棉软禁，1991巴黎协议复位，以舞者外交在五大势力夹缝生存半世纪。
description_en: Norodom Sihanouk (1922-2012) Cambodia King/Prince/PM, 1953 negotiated independence, 1955 abdicated entered politics, 1970 coup exiled Beijing, 1975 Khmer Rouge house arrest, 1991 Paris Agreement restored, dancer diplomacy survived half century in five powers squeeze.
reason_zh: 西哈努克代表冷战东南亚小国君主通过多重身份转换与艺术外交在大国博弈中生存的奇迹，展示了国王-舞者-外交官三位一体如何拆解意识形态对立。
reason_en: Sihanouk represents Cold War Southeast Asian small state monarch surviving in great power game through multiple identity shifts and artistic diplomacy miracle, demonstrating how King-Dancer-Diplomat trinity deconstructs ideological opposition.
steps_zh: 研究西哈努克早年法国教育与1941年日本扶植即位
分析1953独立谈判与1955退位桑库姆政治
探讨1970政变流亡北京与红色高棉复杂关系
评估1991巴黎协议1993复位与舞者外交遗产
总结国王舞者外交中立生存对夹缝小国的普遍启示
steps_en: Study Sihanouk early French education and 1941 Japanese installation
Analyze 1953 independence negotiation and 1955 abdication Sangkum politics
Explore 1970 coup exile Beijing and Khmer Rouge complex relationship
Evaluate 1991 Paris Agreement 1993 restoration and dancer diplomacy legacy
Summarize King dancer diplomacy neutral survival universal lessons for squeeze small states
expected_zh: 理解多重身份如何转化为生存外交杠杆，掌握艺术软实力在硬实力对抗中的非对称优势，评估西哈努克模式对当代柬埔寨政治文化的复杂遗产。
expected_en: Understand how multiple identities convert to survival diplomatic leverage, grasp artistic soft power asymmetric advantage in hard power confrontation, evaluate Sihanouk model complex legacy for contemporary Cambodian political culture.
case_zh: 1922 出生；1941 即位；1953 独立；1955 退位；1970 政变；1991 巴黎；1993 复位；2012 逝世。国王舞者外交中立范式永存。
case_en: 1922 birth; 1941 accession; 1953 independence; 1955 abdication; 1970 coup; 1991 Paris; 1993 restoration; 2012 death. King dancer diplomacy neutral paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Neutral survival model; artistic diplomacy; monarchy restoration; Cambodian tragedy witness
